annotations.title: Net salary: Morocco vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in Morocco (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many MAD, for the euro amounts. Default 10.7 (indicative).

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in Morocco, in MAD

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.

pension_pct.description: Voluntary employee pension contribution through payroll, % of salary. Default 0.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in MAD, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.

name: compare_with_netherlands
